# Input README for a fictional product: Plainlog

Plainlog lets a solo developer paste a log file, search within it, and download
matching lines as text. It runs in the browser. No security certification,
hosting, customer count, or team collaboration is specified. Primary CTA:
"Open the sample log". Use plain HTML/CSS; no framework migration.
